episodes.title: Measurement contract
episodes.objective: Verify the declared prompt, output and latency measurement contract on each selected endpoint.
episodes.limitation: This rehearsal does not replace the pinned ShareGPT and GSM8K release-validation protocol.

cells.label: Short request contract
cells.prompt: Explain the difference between time to first token and generation speed in three precise sentences.

cells.label: Structured acceptance contract
cells.prompt: Return JSON with keys definition, risk, and check describing one inference benchmarking error.

episodes.title: Equal-work runtime baseline
episodes.objective: Send identical work to the selected runtime profiles and retain per-lane latency and output-length evidence.
episodes.limitation: Cold start, device telemetry, exact tokenizer equality and randomized arm order require the formal runner.

cells.label: Equal short work
cells.prompt: Summarize why equal work is necessary when comparing LLM serving runtimes.

cells.label: Equal longer work
cells.prompt: Write a technical note separating workload equality, output-length equality, quality gates, latency, throughput, and cost.

episodes.title: Prefix reuse
episodes.objective: Repeat an exact shared prefix across selected endpoints to rehearse cache-sensitive observations.
episodes.limitation: The bridge cannot reset or verify engine prefix-cache state or read native cache-hit counters.

cells.label: Exact shared-prefix probe
cells.prompt: Shared reference: alpha beta gamma delta epsilon. Using only that reference, state the third and fifth terms.

cells.label: Exact-prefix repeat
cells.prompt: Shared reference: alpha beta gamma delta epsilon. Using only that reference, state the third and fifth terms.

episodes.title: Batching and scheduling
episodes.objective: Rehearse mixed short and long requests under bounded client concurrency.
episodes.limitation: Native scheduler queues, chunk budgets and starvation metrics remain unavailable unless captured outside the endpoint.

cells.label: Short traffic
cells.prompt: Define continuous batching.

cells.label: Long traffic
cells.prompt: Explain continuous batching, chunked prefill, queue delay, decode gaps, fairness, and starvation as separate scheduling concerns.

episodes.title: Attention and precision
episodes.objective: Compare endpoint profiles that the operator has pinned to attention/precision variants.
episodes.limitation: The bridge cannot verify actual kernel dispatch or checkpoint/KV precision; attach operator-side provenance.

cells.label: Precision quality probe
cells.prompt: Solve carefully and return only the integer: 173 multiplied by 29.

episodes.title: Speculation and structured output
episodes.objective: Exercise structured output behavior on profiles configured for baseline or speculative decoding.
episodes.limitation: Accepted draft tokens and verification duration require runtime-native telemetry.

cells.label: Structured JSON probe
cells.prompt: Return valid JSON only with keys answer and confidence. The answer is the capital of Japan and confidence is a number from 0 to 1.

episodes.title: Single-node parallelism
episodes.objective: Compare profiles already deployed with declared single-node DP or TP layouts.
episodes.limitation: The bridge does not configure topology or capture collectives, rank placement, NVLink traffic, or memory per rank.

cells.label: Single-node serving probe
cells.prompt: Explain one tradeoff between data parallelism and tensor parallelism for inference.

episodes.title: Multi-node parallelism
episodes.objective: Compare profiles already deployed on documented multi-node layouts.
episodes.limitation: Node placement, network transport and collective telemetry must be supplied by the operator.

cells.label: Multi-node serving probe
cells.prompt: Name the evidence needed to attribute a multi-node inference slowdown to communication.

episodes.title: Disaggregation and routing
episodes.objective: Compare profiles representing colocated or disaggregated/routed serving paths.
episodes.limitation: KV transfer, cache ownership and routing decisions require platform telemetry not exposed by this bridge.

cells.label: Short routed request
cells.prompt: Define cache-aware routing in one sentence.

cells.label: Long routed request
cells.prompt: Explain how queue delay, cache reuse, load skew, cancellation and fairness interact in cache-aware routing.

episodes.title: Slurm and Kubernetes
episodes.objective: Exercise service reachability for profiles hosted by the declared orchestration platforms.
episodes.limitation: This does not submit Slurm jobs, mutate Kubernetes, test autoscaling, or validate recovery; platform adapters and evidence are external.

cells.label: Platform service probe
cells.prompt: List the operational evidence needed to compare Slurm jobs with Kubernetes inference services.

episodes.title: Model internals
episodes.objective: Rehearse the observable generation contract that accompanies the model-internals lab.
episodes.limitation: An inference endpoint cannot inspect weights, activations, gradients or optimizer state; the core tensor lab remains external.

cells.label: Observable output contract
cells.prompt: Describe how embeddings, attention, logits, and sampling transform input tokens into generated tokens.

episodes.title: LoRA and QLoRA
episodes.objective: Compare the serving-side acceptance behavior of profiles configured for base or adapter artifacts.
episodes.limitation: This does not train LoRA or QLoRA, measure training memory, or verify adapter lineage; profiles must already expose the intended artifacts.

cells.label: Adapter acceptance probe
cells.prompt: Classify this support request as billing, technical, or account and give a one-sentence rationale: My deployment returns HTTP 503 after loading the model.

episodes.title: Jev and LLM decisions
episodes.objective: Exercise the shared labeled-decision response contract on configured endpoint profiles.
episodes.limitation: This bridge is OpenAI-compatible; a Jev adapter and labeled corpus are still required for the canonical comparison.

cells.label: Typed decision probe
cells.prompt: Return exactly one label from [ALLOW, REVIEW, DENY] for: confidence is low and required evidence is missing.

episodes.title: Packaging and memory preflight
episodes.objective: Check endpoint reachability, streaming completion and bounded longer-context behavior.
episodes.limitation: GPU visibility, image digest, memory telemetry, controlled OOM and recovery require operator-side evidence.

cells.label: Streaming preflight
cells.prompt: List five checks for validating an inference container before performance testing.

cells.label: Bounded context probe
cells.prompt: Explain how KV-cache growth relates to input length, output length, concurrency, and memory pressure.

episodes.title: Saturation, SLO and cost
episodes.objective: Rehearse bounded concurrent requests and retain runner-observed latency/error aggregates.
episodes.limitation: This bounded bridge is not a saturation harness and does not establish maximum goodput or provider cost.

cells.label: Bounded load probe
cells.prompt: Explain SLO-qualified goodput in two sentences.

episodes.title: Release gates and recovery
episodes.objective: Run a bounded acceptance rehearsal across candidate profiles and retain sanitized results for gate review.
episodes.limitation: Rollback, fault injection, artifact provenance and provider cleanup remain separate controlled procedures.

cells.label: Release quality probe
cells.prompt: Return valid JSON only with keys status and reason. Set status to ready only if correctness, latency, error-rate, and cost gates all pass; otherwise use review.

cells.label: Repeatability probe
cells.prompt: State why a release gate must reject a faster configuration when its quality threshold fails.

compatibility: Historical episode-suite results retain episode-catalog.v1 IDs; use previousEpisode plus the catalog mapping when comparing them with current plans.
